title: Form app agent manifest
description: agents/manifest.json in a Form app repository: what the app offers agents at a released tag. Written by the app's own agents sync and kept true by its --check. See docs/SPEC.md.

app.description: The registry name, the file name of the app's entry in formcompiler apps/.

mcp.description: The app's MCP server, or null when it has none.

tools.description: Every tool name the server lists.

read_only.description: The tools that change nothing. Each must be in tools.

approval_gated.description: The tools that wait for the person's approval in the app before acting. Each must be in tools.

dispatch.description: Optional. Tools that run many commands or tools by name, so the app offers more than tools lists. Left out when no tool does.

tool.description: The dispatching tool; it must be in tools, once.

reaches.description: How many commands or tools it can run that tools does not list.

skills.description: Every skill folder the app ships, in the order of its skills folder.

present.description: The app has the family's agent dock.

extensions.description: The form.ext host API version the app implements, or null when it hosts no extensions.
